dockerfile:
FROM python:3.13
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip3 install poetry' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -lc 'apt-get update && apt-get install -y libudev-dev libhidapi-dev gcc python3-dev' && JAYINT_APT_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_APT_STATUS=$?; (apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; if [ "$JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_APT_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_APT_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_APT_STATUS"

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed


cd /testbed

set +e
(
cd /testbed && poetry run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

build_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libudev-dev libhidapi-dev gcc python3-dev

excluded_commands.command: python3 --version && which python3 && which pip3 (read-only check)
cd /workspace/... && poetry install --with dev (wrong directory, failed)
cd /app && poetry install --with dev (failed due to missing system deps, superseded by later success)
cd /app && poetry run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings (test command, excluded from build commands)

build_recipe.rationale: The successful setup trajectory consisted of: installing poetry via pip, installing required system dependencies for the hidapi build (libudev-dev, libhidapi-dev, gcc, python3-dev), and then installing the project with dev dependencies via poetry. These three commands were executed successfully in order and led to the final test collection passing. The test command is reserved for the tests section; all read-only probes, failed attempts, and compound commands are excluded. The commands are kept separate per the rule that independent install steps should not be merged.
